info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Facilities Equipment Maintenance By Equipment Maintenance Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to update specific details related to the maintenance of banking facilities equipment identified by a unique maintenance ID. It supports the modification of attributes associated with maintenance records, enabling organizations to efficiently manage their equipment upkeep. Common users include facility managers and maintenance personnel who require real-time updates to track and enhance operational efficiency. This API streamlines the maintenance record management process, ensuring that data remains accurate and up to date.

patch.summary: Update the maintenance details for specific equipment.
patch.description: This operation allows the user to update maintenance records for the equipment identified by RES-100045. It provides flexibility in modifying various attributes related to the maintenance status, schedules, and notes associated with the equipment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the equipment maintenance details for a specific facility. It requires the specification of fields that indicate the changes to be made, ensuring that any required data is provided to successfully perform the update.

200.description: The update was successful and the resource is returned.
